decisions.reason: As a 2019 product that was only briefly mentioned rather than strongly featured, the construction site dumper appears to have attracted relatively limited public commitment and can be more easily discontinued if results have been unclear.

The inclined furniture lift was given its own page and offered as a multi-model line, indicating visible commitment and investment that would incline management to continue it unless failure had become unmistakable.

The inclined building material lift also had a dedicated page and several models, making it a more substantial and publicly backed line that management is likely to persist with under disappointing but still explainable results.

The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift was publicly presented on its own page, but as a narrower single product than D and E it carries less sunk-line commitment and is therefore somewhat more exposed to withdrawal while still more likely to be retained than not.
